name: Dify Augmented Search
description: Placeable Drupal block that detects search queries and shows AI-generated answers from a Dify Workflow alongside normal search results, streamed through a server-side proxy.
project_description: Dify Augmented Search is a submodule of the Dify project. It provides a placeable Drupal block plugin (AugmentedSearchBlock, id dify_augmented_search_block) that detects a search query on the page and renders a streaming AI-generated answer from a Dify Workflow next to the normal search results. The block's base URL and token are stored in Drupal State keyed by a per-block UUID; the front-end JavaScript posts the query to the server-side ChatProxyController (/dify-augmented-search/api/chat), which looks up the block credentials by UUID and streams the Dify Workflow run (/v1/workflows/run, stateless single-turn) via the base module's DifyChatProxyService, keeping the token server-side. Markdown answers are rendered through the base module's MarkdownController. The block is configurable for the markdown theme, an optional AI/normal search toggle, the form selectors and URL search parameters it watches, the Dify input variable name, and colors. Requires the dify base module and league/commonmark ^2.8.
